# sendgrid_list (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid Marketing Campaigns contact list: a static collection of contacts. To add contacts to a list, use the Contacts API (not yet covered by this provider).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_list" "newsletter" {
  name = "newsletter-subscribers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The list's name.

### Read-Only

- `contact_count` (Number) The number of contacts currently on this list.
- `id` (String) The list's UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_list.newsletter <list_id>
```
